references.text: Thematic parallel illustrating the moral decay and brutality characteristic of the period of the Judges, where 'the edge of the sword' becomes an instrument of total destruction in both cases.
Direct narrative precursor: 1 Sam 11:1 describes the siege and agreement that led to Jabesh being regarded as traitors and thus targeted for massacre in Judg 21:10.
Narrative context: Judg 20:48 is the immediate premise for Judg 21:10, where both parts of the same war account use 'the edge of the sword' to describe total destruction.
